about_the_game:
Hunt. Transform. Escape.

Simple, you say? Adorable. 

Enter a city consumed by supernatural decay. Summon a colossal Gloomfiend and claim its reward. 

The streets crawl with lesser horrors, things that whisper, writhe, and remember your name. Only some of them are human. 

Form alliances with fellow players… or don’t. Stay hidden and focus on the kill, pursue your personal appetites, or hunt your rivals to thin the field. We won’t judge. We’ve seen much worse. 

Complete the ritual. 

Earn your reward. 

Try not to lose yourself along the way. 

You Are Not the Apex Predator

But you can always pretend. 

Nightholme is a multiplayer horror game built on tension, transformation, and decisions you’ll insist were necessary at the time. Choose your Grimrunner, study your prey, and drink the Nocturn serum to lock in the monstrous archetype lurking just beneath your skin. 

Channel corruption to become a Grimspawn, trading stealth and restraint for a surge of exquisite violence. Shape your build through a flexible skill tree that alters how you move, fight, and survive. As inhuman as the things you hunt. Magnificent, isn’t it?

These forms are not cosmetic indulgences. Each archetype brings distinct abilities and synergies that reward timing, strategy, and a healthy appetite for risk. 

So drink deep… but don’t get attached. Every transformation is a step toward insanity’s sweet embrace. 

Strategic Multiplayer Horror

No one gives you orders, do they, darling? 

Twelve Grimrunners enter every match, each driven by their own ambitions. Cooperation is optional. Sometimes efficient, more often delightfully ill-advised. 

The city provides opportunities, not obligations. Hunt the Gloomfiend or complete other quests. Scavenge, stalk, or grind for power. Sabotage others and take what they earned. Indulge yourself. We encourage it. 

Progression persists between runs, unlocking new rewards, upgrades, and strategies. Mastery is rewarded. Complacency is… addressed. 

Optional High-Stakes Boss Hunts 

Madness begins at the end. 

As the run nears its end, the city offers one last temptation. Summon a unique Gloomfiend, larger and more grotesque than anything you’ve faced so far. 

The Terror Seeds they drop are glorious. Some would say worth the risk. But nothing is mandatory here. A bloodsoaked battle with an eldritch monstrosity is completely optional. If you can resist. 

A City That Watches Back

You were noticed the moment you arrived. 

Explore a decaying urban sprawl dense with verticality, interiors, and forgotten paths. Slip through alleys. Track movement through walls. The city reacts to your presence, and it lives to see you squirm. 

Horrors lurk around every corner. One second, you’re the hunter. The next, you’re prey. Pick the wrong fight at the wrong time, and you will be corrected. Thoroughly. 

Abandon hope of conquering this place. The best you can do is appease it.

A Horrifying New World

Familiar shapes, distorted proportions. 

Inspired by cosmic horror and dark folklore, Nightholme twists your precious tropes until they beg for mercy. 

The world is lush and endlessly replayable. Leaving becomes a merely theoretical exercise. Stylized visuals lure you in, but secrets are what close the door behind you. 

The deeper you descend, the stranger it gets. You do have an escape plan… don’t you? 

So… Ready to Begin?

Marvelous. 

Twelve Grimrunners enter a city. 

Some leave with what they came for. 

No one leaves the same. 

Welcome home. We’ve been so eager to meet you.

name: Nightholme

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, with a minimum of 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 / Intel Arc B580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card

short_description: Team up or strike out alone to hunt an eldritch Gloomfiend in a city crawling with horrors. Channel corruption and transform into a monstrous Grimspawn for devastating bursts of power. But beware. Madness is patient, and you look delicious. Survive the run. Take the prize. No one leaves unchanged.

English*, French, German, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
